inviter_text: If you are a current Studio member and not staff, invite a new member. If the recipient enrolls and makes the first payment by 12 July, any applicable inviter reward remains unresolved because its form and delivery condition were not supplied. Enroll by 12 July.
recipient_text: A current Studio member may invite you if you are new. Enroll and make the first payment by 12 July. Any recipient reward is unresolved in the supplied rules. Enroll by 12 July.
short_disclosure: For a current, non-staff member inviting a new member: the recipient must enroll and make the first payment by 12 July. The inviter reward form and delivery condition are not supplied, so the reward claim is unresolved; recipient reward terms are also not supplied.
ineligible_case_response: A person who is not a current Studio member or is staff cannot be the inviter. A recipient who is not new does not meet the supplied eligibility condition.
